title: Solar and storage: Building a more resilient and secure energy system
summary: The battery energy storage system (BESS) solution for a manufacturing plant may look different from what it is for data centre, a renewable energy project or a grid-scale application. The industry will therefore need to move towards more application-specific thinking. Engineering, system design and lifecycle economics will become increasingly important as storage moves from early adoption into larger-scale deployment.
